verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a multi-user permissions system with dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage, so multiple users or organizations can share one instance while keeping their data separate. Sessions are scoped per user, and the founder cites per-user graphs plus user permissions and graph filtering. This covers the private-isolation half well, but selective sharing of memory to a team or across agents is only implied by 'dataset-scoped permissions' and never explicitly described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of granting or sharing datasets to other users, teams or agents; group/team memory constructs; cross-agent shared-memory examples; independent or hands-on corroboration.
